review_notes: The Brunei High Commission in Dhaka requires Bangladeshi citizens to hold a visa endorsed in the passport before departure; visa on arrival is not accepted by Bangladesh Immigration. Visit visa is single-entry, BDT2,100, valid up to three months, and normally takes five working days excluding submission. Passport must have six months validity and four blank pages. The Dhaka checklist requires six-month financial evidence with a consistently maintained BDT300,000 balance, confirmed flights, hotel reservation if needed, and printed international health insurance of at least BND10,000. Apply at least two weeks before travel.
